propositions: Version numbers must be bumped in lockstep across pyproject.toml and server.json (top-level and packages[] entry) for the 0.10.1 patch release.
CHANGELOG.md must be updated with a curated [0.10.1] section and compare-link footer prior to commit.
Release commit must pass local gates (lint, typecheck, test) and artifact validation (build, twine check) before pushing to Gerrit.
Release commit must land on main through Gerrit with both LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1 votes, then be dispatched via gh workflow run release.yml with PyPI deployment approval.
Post-release verification must confirm version presence on PyPI, GitHub Release creation at the correct SHA, and package installability.
